title: Genesis 1:1: seven Hebrew words numbered above a menorah
summary: Genesis 1:1 in English (the first “the” is struck through; the other two “the” are underlined) over the Hebrew with transliteration, the seven Hebrew words numbered 1 to 7 from right to left, and beneath them a menorah drawn from Stars of David and slashes with the fourth word, et (את), on the centre stem. In the Hebrew and transliteration the definite article ה / ha is underlined in הארץ and השמים.

text.text: In ~~the~~ beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
bereshit · bara · elohim · et · hashamayim · v’et · ha’aretz
בראשית ברא אלהים את השמים ואת הארץ׃
1 · 2 · 3 · 4 · 5 · 6 · 7 (one number under each Hebrew word, counted right to left: 1 בראשית, 2 ברא, 3 אלהים, 4 את, 5 השמים, 6 ואת, 7 הארץ)

numbers.note: the seven Hebrew words of Genesis 1:1, numbered 1–7 above a seven-branched menorah

pictures.description: A seven-branched menorah drawn in blue Stars of David joined by slashes and vertical bars, three branches curving up on each side of a straight centre stem, with a base at the bottom. Numbers 1 to 7 sit above the branches, one under each of the Hebrew words of Genesis 1:1.
